describe: A thing: what can be hit, as data (the prop it stands as, its hit points, how long it stays down, its track and speed), with a unit test that strikes it down, sees it stand again after its rise and slides it along its track (PLAN.md WP 10.4).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/things/<name> (its id is thing:<name>; a scene stands it with spawnThing): labs/box/things/popper
